title: Marvel Comics
section: The Comic Art of Star Wars
description: Marvel Comics' adaptation of STAR WARS helped generate excitement for the movie. Marvel asked its other comic artists to do their interpretation of the trilogy, and ran them as bonus "pin-ups." Here (front) are the Rebel heroes on Hoth in THE EMPIRE STRIKES BACK as seen by then-X-MEN embellisher Terry Austin. On the back is a cover from the EMPIRE adaptation, which was drawn by Al Williamson and Carlos Garzon.
